title: Add a UI5 provider and button
objective: Compose a UI5 React component inside its provider.
tasks: Import ThemeProvider and Button from their @ui5/webcomponents-react component paths.
Wrap the existing main element in ThemeProvider.
Replace the native button with Button, keeping its Load pallet text; confirm it renders and accepts keyboard focus.
hints: The lesson already includes matching UI5 v2 dependencies.
Place the provider inside App for this exercise; the generated entry does not add another one.

title: Wire actions and register icons
objective: Update React state from UI5 buttons with registered icons.
tasks: Add loaded state initialized to 0 and render it in the pallet count with aria-live="polite".
Wire Load pallet to increment and add Reset shipment to set loaded to 0.
Import add.js and refresh.js from @ui5/webcomponents-icons/dist, then give the buttons matching icon names.
Use Tab and Enter or Space to load a few pallets and reset; keep visible button text.
hints: The side-effect imports register the icon names; setting icon alone does not register an icon.
Use a functional updater when incrementing from the previous value.

title: Show progress and enforce capacity
objective: Derive a percentage and keep loading bounded at ten pallets.
tasks: Import ProgressIndicator and derive progress as (loaded / 10) * 100.
Render it with value, displayValue, and an accessibleName describing shipment progress.
Clamp the Load updater to ten and disable Load pallet at capacity.
Confirm five loads show 50%, ten show 100%, another load is unavailable, and Reset restores 0% and the enabled action.
hints: The pinned UI5 v2 indicator uses value for a 0–100 percentage, not the raw 0–10 pallet count.
Reset only loaded; the percentage and disabled state should follow automatically.
